effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
[All Turns] When your Digimon or Tamers are played or digivolve, if any of them have [Greymon] or [Matt Ishida] in their names, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name in the hand without paying the cost.
